handbook.what: Paying for your own tutoring dashboard when you teach on your own rather than inside a school. It is one seat, for you.
handbook.where: The **Upgrade** button on your tutoring dashboard.
how: Choose Monthly or Annual — annual works out at two months free.
Tap **Subscribe** and fill in the card details on the payment panel that opens on the page.
Once it is running, the same button becomes **Manage subscription** for invoices and cancellation.
handbook.note: Your students pay for their own learning separately, so three paying students cover what your dashboard costs.
